BiblicalUsage: Shashai was a son of Bani who put away his foreign wife in the days of Ezra. His name means noble, and his story is one line in the list of those who obeyed.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe nobility is shown in obedience, not in birth, for Shashai put away what God forbade, and I hold that the cost of obedience is the proof of it.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
